ags: Eight-digit Amtlicher Gemeindeschlüssel, leading zeros kept. Join key.
municipality_name: Gemeinde name; never used as a join key, names repeat.
district_ags: Five-digit AGS of the Kreis or kreisfreie Stadt.
district_name: Name of the Kreis or kreisfreie Stadt.
state_code: Two-digit Bundesland code, the first two AGS digits.
policy_region_id: The unit at which the KdU rule is set: the Kreis AGS (D1).
jobcenter_id: Id of the Jobcenter serving the Kreis, from the BA Jobcenter-to-Kreis crosswalk. Missing for Berlin, where twelve Bezirks-Jobcenter share the single Gemeinde and no one id describes it (A10).
geometry_vintage: Gebietsstand of the boundary and lookup data.
household_size: Number of household members h, 1 to 5.
analysis_date: The Analysestichtag every row is read at (D2).
valid_from: Date the cited rule took effect, as the collectors recorded it.
valid_to: Always missing: every rule here is the one in force at the Stichtag.
source_id: Identifier of the primary cited document in source_register.csv.
source_id_all: Pipe-joined ids of every document the citation names.
source_document: The citation string exactly as the wide CSV records it.
source_title: Title of the primary source, from the manifest label or filename.
source_institution: Kreise that cite this source, i.e. the responsible Träger.
source_type: thome or own_research; missing when no file is held.
source_location: URL where one exists, otherwise the corpus-relative path.
publication_date: Always missing: no collection step recorded one.
retrieval_date: Date the held file was last written in the corpus.
source_hash: sha256 of the held source file; missing for web-only citations.
has_primary_document: Whether the citation resolves to a file in the corpus.
quality_tier: A, B, or C under §6.4, as fixed by quality_tier_reason.
quality_tier_reason: The single fact that fixed the tier.
household_sizes_complete: A cap exists for all of h = 1 to 4, the main-analysis sizes.
kdu_value_raw: The euro amount as published, before harmonisation.
cost_concept_raw: bruttokaltmiete or nettokaltmiete, as the source defines it.
max_area_sqm: Admissible Wohnfläche in m² for this household size.
net_cold_cap_total: Published Nettokaltmiete cap in EUR per month.
net_cold_cap_per_sqm: Published Nettokaltmiete cap in EUR per m² per month.
cold_opex_cap_total: Published kalte Betriebskosten cap in EUR per month.
cold_opex_cap_per_sqm: Published kalte Betriebskosten cap in EUR per m².
gross_cold_cap_total: Published Bruttokaltmiete cap in EUR per month.
gross_cold_cap_per_sqm: Published Bruttokaltmiete cap in EUR per m² per month.
heating_cap_total: Always missing: heating was outside the collection scope.
gross_warm_cap_total: Always missing: Bruttowarmmiete was not collected.
additional_person_amount: Bruttokaltmiete increment per person beyond the fifth.
additional_person_area_sqm: Wohnfläche increment per person beyond the fifth.
product_theory_flag: The source works with Produkttheorie (rate times area).
exception_text: Notes text describing a Härtefall or other documented exception.
derived_value_flag: printed, computed, or unknown; never guessed at.
kdu_bkc_cap: The analysis variable: the Bruttokaltmiete cap in EUR per month.
kdu_bkc_cap_scenario_low: Extended sample only: Netto-only cap, low cold-opex.
kdu_bkc_cap_scenario_mid: Extended sample only: Netto-only cap, mid cold-opex.
kdu_bkc_cap_scenario_high: Extended sample only: Netto-only cap, high cold-opex.
cold_opex_scenario_applied: Whether the scenario band was used for this row.
wogg_base_cap: § 12 Absatz 1 WoGG Höchstbetrag, base only, all five household sizes.
wogg_mietstufe: Mietstufe as a KdU document states it, else the statutory value.
wogv_mietstufe: The purely statutory Mietstufe from the Anlage zur WoGV.
wogg_rent_level_missing: No statutory Mietenstufe exists, so no benchmark does (A2).
wogg_linked_notes: Detector 1: the notes say WoGG table plus Sicherheitszuschlag.
wogg_linked_ratio: Detector 2: K/W sits at the 10 % markup across household sizes.
wogg_link_detectors_agree: The two detectors agree; disagreements go to review.
n_wogg_ratios: Household sizes for which K/W could be formed.
haertefall_regelung: The document prints a quantified Härtefall uplift.
kdu_region: The document's own name for the region this cap applies to.
sample_stratum: Which extended-sample stratum a row belongs to.
n_warn_flags: How many §6.5 checks this row violates. Never an exclusion.
warn_duplicate_key: Check 1: the key is not unique.
warn_ambiguous_policy_region: Check 2: more than one policy region.
warn_non_positive_cap: Check 3: the cap is not a positive finite amount.
warn_non_monotone_in_household_size: Check 4: the cap falls as h rises.
warn_incomplete_household_sizes: Check 6: not every household size has a cap.
warn_extreme_cap: Check 7: the cap is a percentile or absolute outlier.
warn_conflicting_source_values: Check 8: one source gives conflicting caps.
warn_ags_not_in_gebietsstand: Check 10: the AGS is unknown to the lookup.
warn_no_geometry: Check 11: the Gemeinde has no boundary polygon.
all_household_sizes_complete: A cap exists for all of h = 1 to 5.
wogg_rent_level: Statutory Mietenstufe used for the Wohngeld benchmark (P0.2).
wogg_heating_relief: § 12 Absatz 6 WoGG Heizkostenentlastung; never added to a cap.
wogg_bkc_cap: wogg_base_cap plus the Klimakomponente; the D6 robustness benchmark.
wogg_parameter_vintage: Fassung dates of the WoGG parameters used.
